batchRequest.request: Add a fourth week's rainfall readings and mark the driest town with a severe-restrictions tag.

patchOf:
root = Stack([title, kpis, levelsCard, rainCard, restrictionsCard])
title = TextContent("Drought Tracker", "large-heavy")
kpis = SnippetCardBlock([k1, k2, k3])
k1 = SnippetCardItem("avg", k1l, k1r)
k1l = IconText(k1i, "neutral", "m", "Avg Reservoir Level", "All four towns", false, "horizontal")
k1i = Icon("droplets", "nature")
k1r = BoldText("number", "46%", "-3.2%", "metric")
k2 = SnippetCardItem("rain", k2l, k2r)
k2l = IconText(k2i, "neutral", "m", "Weekly Rainfall", "Avg this week", false, "horizontal")
k2i = Icon("cloud-rain", "weather")
k2r = BoldText("number", "7.6 mm", "-1.4%", "metric")
k3 = SnippetCardItem("restr", k3l, k3r)
k3l = IconText(k3i, "warning", "m", "Towns Restricted", "Current status", false, "horizontal")
k3i = Icon("triangle-alert", "alerts")
k3r = BoldText("number", "3 of 4")
levelsCard = Card([levelsHeader, levelsChart])
levelsHeader = CardHeader("Reservoir Levels", "Percent of capacity")
levelsChart = BarChart(towns, [levelSeries], "grouped", "Town", "% capacity")
towns = ["Ashford", "Brookvale", "Carlton", "Dunmore"]
levelSeries = Series("Reservoir level", [58, 41, 27, 63])
rainCard = Card([rainHeader, rainChart, rainTable])
rainHeader = CardHeader("Weekly Rainfall", "Millimetres, last four weeks")
rainChart = LineChart(weeks, [r1, r2, r3, r4], "natural", "Week", "mm")
weeks = ["Week 1", "Week 2", "Week 3", "Week 4"]
r1 = Series("Ashford", [12, 8, 5, 9])
r2 = Series("Brookvale", [9, 6, 4, 7])
r3 = Series("Carlton", [5, 3, 2, 4])
r4 = Series("Dunmore", [14, 10, 8, 11])
rainTable = Table([Col("Town", towns), Col("This week (mm)", thisWeek, "number"), Col("4-week total (mm)", totals, "number")])
thisWeek = [9, 7, 4, 11]
totals = [34, 26, 14, 43]
restrictionsCard = Card([restrictHeader, restrictTable])
restrictHeader = CardHeader("Water Restrictions", "Current level by town")
restrictTable = Table([Col("Town", towns), Col("Restriction", tags), Col("Notes", notes)])
tags = [Tag("Level 2 - Moderate", null, "sm", "warning"), Tag("Level 3 - Severe", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("Level 4 - Critical", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("No restrictions", null, "sm", "success")]
notes = ["Sprinkler ban", "Hose use banned, no car washing", "Outdoor use prohibited", "Voluntary conservation"]
request: Add a fourth week's rainfall readings and mark the driest town with a severe-restrictions tag.
